name: ai-use-case-workshop
description: Guide groups through conversation and visual choices to create their AI use-case portfolio.

interface.shortDescription: Visual group decisions and a growing workbook
interface.longDescription: Work through six phases with goal maps, workflow replay, candidate comparisons and a priority board. Each approved chapter enters the group workbook and triggers a cumulative PDF. The same exercise also works through conversation. This package is a local review candidate, not a live connector update.
defaultPrompt: Help our group identify useful AI use cases.
